name: 115.简·测试
features: remove synchronous get_id probing from first render
reuse cached cloud-download cid immediately and otherwise scan root once for 云下载/离线下载
reduce external-magnet dedup scan from 10 pages to 3 pages

treat socket/read timeout as uncertain submission rather than definite failure
show first-screen status skeleton before remote magnet processing
when fileId is available, expand result folder/video rows inline
retain Stable 1.1.0 playback resolver, dedup cache, retry and multi-video behavior
